description: This file implements Base64 encoding and decoding functions using OpenSSL's EVP API, providing utilities for encoding binary data to Base64 strings and decoding Base64 strings back to binary data within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

methods.name: EncodeBase64
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a Base64 string using OpenSSL EVP functions.

methods.name: DecodeBase64
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 string into binary data using OpenSSL EVP functions.
